svg.title: My Experience
svg.desc: Career timeline: Analytics Engineer at SAGO (Jun 2026 to present), Analytics Intern at SAGO (Jan to May 2026), BI Analyst at Diacto Technologies (Jan 2023 to Aug 2024) with 9+ ETL/ELT workflows, 11+ analytical datasets, 9+ dashboards and 13+ enterprise engagements, and Intern at Diacto Technologies (Sep to Dec 2022).

g.text: Analytics engineering on an AWS lakehouse with Dremio Cloud, Hex and Superset.
Data preparation, source integration, dashboards and reporting automation.
SQL optimization and BI delivery across enterprise engagements.
SQL data preparation, ETL workflows, data validation and dashboards.
